title: Sonoma Ceramics Artist in Residence
source_quote: A self-directed, 6-month residency for emerging and established ceramic artists. Two residencies per year offer a supportive environment to explore ideas, develop a body of work, and exhibit at SCC.
evidence_sentence: The residency includes 24-hour access to a semi-private studio and free firing, glazes, and clay at cost.
evidence_quote: $750/month stipend plus free firing, glazes, and clay at cost.
summary: Six-month residency for emerging and established US-based ceramic artists. Includes private on-site housing, $750/month stipend, 24-hour studio access with personal wheel and storage, free firing and glazes, clay at cost, and a solo exhibition. Two residencies per year. 2027 applications due June 15, 2026.
pay_text: $750/month stipend plus free firing, glazes, and clay at cost
cost_text: $750/month stipend plus free firing, glazes, and clay at cost
